text: dsh-agent-team-roles 是面向 DSH Web 的 agent team 角色管理插件。它将每个团队成员配置注册为独立的 agent preset，并提供角色设置面板与群聊页签。用户可创建角色、选择模式和技能，为角色指定模型，并切换已有工具或 MCP 能力；团队运行时可从面板启用。角色资料保存在插件自己的数据目录中，默认位于 DSH_HOME 下；代码未声明 API Key 或外部服务依赖。

dsh-agent-team-roles manages DSH Web agent team role presets in a visual panel. Create roles, choose modes, models and skills, and toggle existing tool or MCP capabilities. Enable the team runtime from the panel; role data is stored under DSH_HOME. No API key or external service is declared.
想给 agent 团队里的不同成员分别配置角色和能力。
能不能在网页面板里新建团队角色 preset？
我希望不同成员使用不同模型或技能配置。
dsh-agent-team-roles 的功能「成员角色 preset」：从 Web 面板新建角色后，插件会为其保存独立配置并注册为 agent preset。角色可选择模式、模型和技能，也能调整已有能力行。
dsh-agent-team-roles 的功能「团队运行时与群聊入口」：角色页提供团队启用开关，并在会话页签中显示群聊。开关通过面板请求修改团队组合状态；群聊数据由插件路由读取，界面提供团队消息流入口。

dsh-agent-team-roles README · dsh-agent-team-roles：[English](README.en.md) · 中文

给 dsh 的 agent team 的每个成员定义一个**角色**：每个角色是一枚独立可选的 agent preset，
再加两个会话页签：「角色」配置页与「群聊」。只延伸官方接口，不改 dsh 一个字节。

dsh-agent-team-roles README · 它能做什么：| 能力 | 一句话 |
| --- | --- |
| 角色即 preset | 每个角色注册成一枚独立 preset，与内置的 `standard` / `cordis` / `ptc` / `minimal` 并列 |
| 开关式配置面板 | 过滤、只看被改过的行、整类三态开关、分类折叠；一次手势合并成一条批量请求 |
| 只引用，不新增 | 角色的能力行来自部署**当前**的预设，角色只改已有行，不凭空造行 |
| 技能按角色选用 | 技能行的开关与顺序按角色存，宿主侧一次装配 |
| 模型按角色选用 | 每个角色可单独指定 provider / 模型 / 推理强度；留空跟随模板 |
| MCP 开关 | 关掉 = 该角色的 agent 看不到那台 MCP 服务器的工具（可见性过滤，不是再起连接） |
| 启用团队与成员绑定 | `set-team` 打开团队运行时，`bindMembers` 把新建成员绑到同名角色 |
| 会话页签「群聊」 | 不切会话聚合全员消息流，只读投影，不依赖任何外部数据库 |
| `@成员` 派发 | Lead 看到全部成员，`@名字` 直接投递；任务板变化会唤醒 Lead |

dsh-agent-team-roles README · 安装：```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add github:StarSpacePX/dsh-agent-team-roles
```

然后**重启 dsh**。宿主侧的新代码只在新进程里存在，热加载只覆盖客户端侧。

这条命令会把插件装进 profile 并**自动补进 `dsh.profile.bundles`**（不需要手工编辑 profile 的
`package.json`）。⚠️ 用 git 地址安装时，pnpm 默认阻止安装期构建脚本，报错里会打印要写进
`<DSH_HOME>/profiles/web/pnpm-workspace.yaml` 的 `allowBuilds` 条目，照抄后重跑即可。

本地开发时可以直接装目录：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add link:D:/path/to/dsh-agent-team-roles
```

装完确认：`GET /state` 里有没有 `team` 段 —— 有就说明宿主侧是新代码。

dsh-agent-team-roles README · 快速开始：1. 会话页签栏打开「**角色**」页。
2. 最上面打开「**启用智能体团队**」——它会同时选上团队组合包并打开成员绑定。
   两步都会如实回报「已生效」或「已保存，重启 dsh 后生效」。
3. 「新建角色」：它默认以部署当前的预设为底，在能力行表里开关工具 / 技能 / MCP。角色 id 默认带 `team-` 前缀。
4. 把这个 preset 选给一个成员；之后在「群聊」页签看全员消息流。

dsh-agent-team-roles README · 配置：写在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `config:` 段里：

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `dir` | `null` | 角色数据目录；留空 = `<DSH_HOME>/agent-team-roles` |
| `prefix` | `"team-"` | 新建角色时 preset id 的前缀，避免与内置 preset 撞名 |
| `bindMembers` | `false` | 强制打开成员绑定；**改了要重启 dsh** |
| `home` | `null` | dsh 数据根目录；一般留空，走 `DSH_HOME` 或 `~/.dsh` |

```yaml

dsh-agent-team-roles README · <DSH_HOME>/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml：config:
  prefix: team-
  bindMembers: false
```

细读：[配置项](docs/配置项.md)。

dsh-agent-team-roles README · 数据与卸载：- 数据全部在 `<DSH_HOME>/agent-team-roles/`：`roles.json` 索引 + 每个角色一个 `<id>/role.json` 与 `<id>/AGENTS.md`。
- 插件**不改** dsh 包、不改 shipped preset、不改 `~/.dsh/settings.yaml`。
- **卸载插件不会删数据。** 彻底清干净：卸插件 → 重启 dsh → 手动删掉 `agent-team-roles/` 目录。
- 备份就是拷这个目录；恢复就是把目录放回去再重启。

dsh-agent-team-roles README · 文档：全部说明在 [`docs/`](docs/README.md)，索引见那篇。最常看的三篇：
[配置项](docs/配置项.md) · [启用与成员绑定](docs/启用与成员绑定.md) · [日志](docs/日志.md)。

dsh-agent-team-roles README · 边界与已知限制：- **成员创建失败会永久占用这个名字**：这是 dsh 本体的限制，插件修不了。控制并发，失败后别改名重试。
- **群聊页签是只读的**，没有输入框；要发消息走 `@成员` 或工具。
- **写配置类的改动要重启 dsh**，界面只刷新页面即可。
- 面板只做开关，没有逐行 config 编辑器；行名悬停能看到该行的 config。

dsh-agent-team-roles README · 开发：下面的命令只在克隆仓库开发时可用（npm 包里不含 `tests/`）。

```powershell
npm test              # 全量测试
npm run test:drift    # 只跑产物一致性检查
npm run build:client  # 改了 src/client/** 后重建 lib/client.js
npm run accept:live   # 真机验收探针

description: "One role preset per agent-team member for dsh, plus a role settings tab and a read-only team chat tab."
kind: "package-reference"

<!-- 中文版：[README.md](README.md) -->

dsh-agent-team-roles README · dsh-agent-team-roles：Give every member of a dsh agent team its own **role**: each role is a separate, selectable agent
preset, plus two session tabs — "Roles" for settings and "Chat" for the team message flow. It only
extends public interfaces; not a byte of dsh itself is patched.

dsh-agent-team-roles README · What it does：| Capability | In one line |
| --- | --- |
| A role is a preset | Each role registers as its own preset, listed next to the built-in `standard` / `cordis` / `ptc` / `minimal` |
| Switch-based settings | Filter, "only rows this role changed", whole-category tri-state switches, collapsible groups; one gesture becomes one batched request |
| Reference, never invent | A role's capability rows come from the presets the deployment has **right now**; a role only flips switches on existing rows |
| Skills per role | Skill rows and their order are stored per role and assembled on the host side once |
| Model per role | Each role can set its own provider / model / reasoning effort; leave empty to follow the template |
| MCP switches | Off means that role's agent cannot see that MCP server's tools (a visibility filter, not another connection) |
| Team switch and member binding | `set-team` starts the team runtime; `bindMembers` binds a new member to the role of the same name |
| "Chat" tab | One message flow across the whole team without switching sessions; read-only projection, no external database |
| `@member` dispatch | The Lead sees every member

dsh-agent-team-roles README · Install：```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add github:StarSpacePX/dsh-agent-team-roles
```

Then **restart dsh**. New host-side code only exists in a new process; hot reload covers the client
side only.

dsh-agent-team-roles README · Install：This command installs the plugin into the profile and **adds it to `dsh.profile.bundles`** for you
(no need to edit the profile's `package.json` by hand). When installing from a git URL, pnpm blocks
install-time build scripts by default; the error prints the `allowBuilds` entry to put into
`<DSH_HOME>/profiles/web/pnpm-workspace.yaml`. Copy it, then run the command again.

For local development you can install the directory directly:

dsh-agent-team-roles README · Install：```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add link:D:/path/to/dsh-agent-team-roles
```

To check the install: does `GET /state` contain a `team` section? If yes, the host side runs the new
code.

dsh-agent-team-roles README · Quick start：1. Open the "**Roles**" tab in the session tab bar.
2. Turn on "**Enable agent team**". This selects the team bundle and turns on member binding at once.
   Both steps report either "applied" or "saved, takes effect after restarting dsh".
3. Click "**New role**". It starts from the deployment's current preset; use the capability table to
   switch tools / skills / MCP. Role ids get the `team-` prefix by default.
4. Assign that preset to a member. The "Chat" tab then shows the team message flow.

dsh-agent-team-roles README · Configuration：All of it lives in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`, under `config:`:

| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `dir` | `null` | Role data directory; empty means `<DSH_HOME>/agent-team-roles` |
| `prefix` | `"team-"` | Preset id prefix for new roles, so they cannot collide with built-in presets |
| `bindMembers` | `false` | Force member binding on; **restart dsh after changing it** |
| `home` | `null` | dsh data root; usually leave empty — `DSH_HOME` or `~/.dsh` is used |

```yaml

dsh-agent-team-roles README · <DSH_HOME>/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml：config:
  prefix: team-
  bindMembers: false
```

Details: [docs/配置项.md](docs/配置项.md) (Chinese).

dsh-agent-team-roles README · Data and uninstall：- Everything lives in `<DSH_HOME>/agent-team-roles/`: `roles.json` as the index, plus one
  `<id>/role.json` and `<id>/AGENTS.md` per role.
- The plugin does **not** touch the dsh package, shipped presets, or `~/.dsh/settings.yaml`.
- **Uninstalling keeps the data.** To wipe it: remove the plugin, restart dsh, then delete the
  `agent-team-roles/` directory.
- Backup is a copy of that directory; restore puts it back and restarts dsh.

dsh-agent-team-roles README · Docs：All reference pages live in [`docs/`](docs/README.md) (Chinese); its index lists them. The three you
will actually need: [配置项](docs/配置项.md) (configuration), [启用与成员绑定](docs/启用与成员绑定.md)
(team switch and member binding), [日志](docs/日志.md) (logging).

dsh-agent-team-roles README · Limits：- **A failed member creation keeps its name forever.** That is a dsh limitation; the plugin cannot
  fix it. Create one member at a time, and do not retry with a renamed member after a failure.
- **The "Chat" tab is read-only.** To send something, use `@member` or a tool.
- **Changes to stored config need a dsh restart**; interface changes only need a page refresh.
- The settings panel only flips switches — there is no per-row config editor. Hover a row name to
  see that row's config.
